args.purpose: Count reviews created on 2018-09-02 and group by review_score
args.sql:
SELECT 
    review_score,
    COUNT(*) AS review_count
FROM order_reviews
WHERE cast(review_creation_date as date) = '2018-09-02'
GROUP BY review_score
ORDER BY review_score DESC;

args.purpose: Get total reviews and list scores clearly for citation
args.sql:
SELECT 
    sum(review_count) as total_reviews,
    sum(case when review_score = 5 then review_count else 0 end) as score_5_count,
    sum(case when review_score = 3 then review_count else 0 end) as score_3_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        review_score,
        COUNT(*) AS review_count
    FROM order_reviews
    WHERE cast(review_creation_date as date) = '2018-09-02'
    GROUP BY review_score
);
